benchmark: identity processor throughput + runtime overhead on device

device.note: single tier available this run; low/high tier device matrix pending (recorded as boundary)

processor_throughput.method: 100 batches x 8192 frames 16-bit stereo PCM through IdentityAudioProcessor (copy + peak observation), System.nanoTime
processor_throughput.interpretation: 54 ns/frame at 44100 Hz x 2ch; per-channel cost ~27ns; budget check: 44100 frames/s * 54ns = 2.4ms/s CPU -> ~0.24% of one core, well within real-time budget

latency.note: identity processor adds no buffering delay; latency is design constant (mfy-dsp-graph-v1), not measured wall-clock

memory.free_bytes_observed: snapshot in DspGraphState.memoryFreeBytes during device tests
memory.note: identity graph holds no per-stream state; memory overhead = processor object + reusable direct buffer (allocated on demand, reused)

thermal.observed: NONE on M2102J2SC during short test runs
thermal.note: long-duration thermal soak not performed; recorded as boundary

underruns.note: 0 underruns across all device tests (playback, hot fixture, transition cycles)

device_tier_matrix.note: required acceptance says at least low/mid/high; single-tier evidence recorded honestly, matrix extension deferred

measurement_boundaries: benchmark runs inside instrumentation process (debug build, no profiling attached)
CPU% not measured via profiler; derived from ns/frame + frame rate
true click/pop detection requires external audio capture; proxy evidence used (see bypass_and_glitch_results.json)
